## Checklist

- [ ] One topic per pull request (one link/shop, or one small fix).
- [ ] The link was added to the correct `data/links/<room-id>.yaml` file.
- [ ] The URL uses `https://` and has no tracking or affiliate parameters.
- [ ] The link is related to the One Piece Card Game.
- [ ] `icon_source` is set correctly (`fetched` for the normal case, `manual` only if an icon file is included).
- [ ] If an icon file was added manually: square, PNG/SVG/WebP, at least 180×180 px, and I have the right to use it.
- [ ] `php bin/validate-data.php` passes locally (or I accept that CI will check this).
- [ ] For shops: sells One Piece Card Game products, own `https://` website, no affiliate links.
- [ ] For UI changes: screenshots attached (phone and desktop).

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full rules.
